pages.observed: Samples 0.0s to 0.8s of option A. Empty generic restaurant interior, glass door at left ajar, host stand with phone and hanging dark apron at right, window to grey river landscape. No person visible. Caption at 0.6s and 0.8s reads 'When the only server at Wok and Karahi in Spring walked out,'. Door panel position differs slightly at 0.8s.

Samples 1.0s to 1.8s of option A. Same empty restaurant interior; the glass door is fully closed in all five samples. Host stand with phone and hanging apron unchanged. No person visible. Caption 'When the only server at Wok and Karahi in Spring walked out,' persists. Frames appear identical across the page.

Samples 2.0s to 2.8s of option A. Wide empty interior holds to 2.4s while a Texas outline locator card appears top-right. At 2.6s cut to a medium close shot of the host stand: open lined order pad, black desk phone, dark apron hanging from a hook. At 2.8s curved ring marks appear on both sides of the phone handset. Caption unchanged. Caption band overlaps the apron area.

Samples 3.0s to 3.8s of option A. Same close shot of host stand with unanswered ringing phone: ring arcs and a small yellow light pulse on and off. Order pad untouched, apron hangs from hook. Texas locator outline is being stroked around the state border. No hand or person. Caption unchanged and sits across the middle of the stand and upper apron.

Samples 4.0s to 4.8s of option A. Same static close shot of the host stand, phone ringing with arcs and yellow light alternating. Pad and apron unchanged; no hand answers. Texas locator outline now complete, a small mark near the upper Gulf coast. Caption present to 4.4s, absent at 4.6s and 4.8s revealing the full apron.

Samples 5.0s to 5.8s of option A. Cut to a wide dining-room shot: two small seated diners at two-top tables in front of the window, one teal, one orange reading a menu who lifts a hand. Host stand with pad and phone cropped at right edge, phone ring arcs visible. Wall clock between lamps. Texas locator adds a small circle near the Houston area. Diners are small in frame. Caption reads 'who was going to take the order?'.

Samples 6.0s to 6.8s of option A. Same wide dining-room framing held from 5.0s. Orange diner keeps one hand raised behind a menu; teal diner seated still. Phone at the right edge shows ring arcs most samples. Nobody approaches the tables. Caption 'who was going to take the order?' stays. Frame otherwise unchanged.

Samples 7.0s to 7.8s of option A. Dining room wide held through 7.6s with orange diner's hand raised; caption leaves at 7.4s. At 7.8s cut to the entrance: a blank white sign hangs in the window, a black dark-screen tablet stands on a pole next to the host stand with its phone and hanging apron, door at left edge. Label now reads 'Illustration. Generic panel, no real software or brand mark'. No caption at 7.8s.

Samples 8.0s to 8.8s of option A. Entrance view held: blank white paper sign on a string swings a little and settles; black tablet on a stand stays dark; host stand with phone and apron at right. Texas locator fades away at 8.0s. Caption 'The family didn't post a job ad.' from 8.2s. The sign carries no lettering.

Samples 9.0s to 9.8s of option A. Entrance view unchanged from 8.6s: blank paper sign hanging still, black tablet screen dark, host stand with phone and hanging apron. Caption 'The family didn't post a job ad.' throughout. All five samples appear identical.

Samples 10.0s to 10.8s of option A. Entrance view still unchanged since about 8.6s: blank sign, dark tablet, host stand, door edge. Caption 'The family didn't post a job ad.' to 10.4s, absent 10.6s and 10.8s. No motion visible between samples.

Samples 11.0s to 11.8s of option A. Cut to a closer shot of the black tablet on its pole stand. From 11.4s a teal screen wipes across from left; by 11.8s it shows a concentric-ring icon and the name 'Haniya' with two lines beneath. Caption 'They put an AI host named Haniya at the front of the house.' overlaps the pole below the panel.

Samples 12.0s to 12.8s of option A. Close shot held on the tablet panel showing a ring icon and 'Haniya' with a faint halo behind the panel. Caption 'They put an AI host named Haniya at the front of the house.' persists. Samples look identical.

Samples 13.0s to 13.8s of option A. Panel held at 13.0s to 13.2s; at 13.4s a tighter framing enlarges the Haniya panel (left side). A hanging paper tag enters from the right and by 13.8s reads 'AI host'. The caption now covers the bottom edge of the enlarged panel.

Samples 14.0s to 14.8s of option A. Tight panel framing held; the 'AI host' paper tag lands and settles pinned on the upper-right of the Haniya screen, partly over the ring icon. Caption covers the bottom of the panel. No other change.

Samples 15.0s to 15.8s of option A. Haniya panel with AI host tag held to 15.4s; caption gone at 15.4s. At 15.6s cut to a table-top view: a QR code table tent stands on a wooden base with a plate and glass nearby; a brown-skinned hand at bottom holds a smartphone whose screen shows a QR code. New label 'Illustration of the reported ordering flow. Generic phone, not a real code or screen'. No caption at 15.6s to 15.8s.

Samples 16.0s to 16.8s of option A. A hand in a blue sleeve lifts a smartphone from the frame bottom up past the caption band toward and beside the QR table tent; the phone screen displays a QR code throughout. At 16.4s the phone passes behind the caption box. At 16.6s it is next to the tent; at 16.8s it is held above the tent rather than aimed at it. Caption 'A guest scans a code at the table,'.

Samples 17.0s to 17.8s of option A. The hand holds the phone raised above and left of the QR table tent, screen facing the viewer and showing a QR code. Phone and tent do not visibly align; the phone faces the camera, not the tent. At 17.8s a small orange-red strip appears at the lower part of the phone screen. Forearm crosses the caption band. Caption 'A guest scans a code at the table,'.

Samples 18.0s to 18.8s of option A. Phone stays raised in the same hand; its screen changes from the QR code to a menu list with an orange header, several rows with icons, one row text resembling 'Chow mein', and a bottom bar with a black 'Pay' pill. Text on the phone screen is very small at phone size. Caption 'A guest scans a code at the table,' to 18.6s, absent at 18.8s.

Samples 19.0s to 19.8s of option A. Wide phone shot at 19.0s, then a close-up from 19.2s: phone held in one hand shows a menu list with a 'Chow mein' row and bottom buttons 'Talk' (mic icon) and 'Pay'. A second hand's index finger enters at 19.4s, touches the Chow mein row at 19.6s, and at 19.8s the row turns yellow and its toggle fills dark. Caption 'taps or talks to order,'. The Talk button is visible but not pressed.

Samples 20.0s to 20.8s of option A. Close-up of phone with Chow mein row highlighted yellow. The tapping hand pulls away out of frame at lower right by 20.4s; the phone and highlighted row then hold unchanged through 20.8s. Talk button never activated. Caption 'taps or talks to order,'.

Samples 21.0s to 21.8s of option A. Close-up phone held with no caption at 21.0s to 21.2s, then at 21.4s a wider framing shrinks the phone in the frame. Caption 'and pays from a phone.' from 21.4s. A second hand enters lower right at 21.6s and at 21.8s its index finger approaches the bottom of the phone near the Pay button, not yet in contact. Phone screen text is small at this framing.

Samples 22.0s to 22.8s of option A. The second hand's index finger presses the Pay button at the bottom of the phone at 22.0s to 22.2s; at 22.4s the button turns to a red badge, and by 22.6s the bottom row shows tiny 'Paid' text with a red check mark circle while the finger withdraws. 22.8s phone held with the Paid check visible. The check mark is small relative to the 270-pixel frame. Caption 'and pays from a phone.'.

Samples 23.0s to 23.8s of option A. Phone with tiny 'Paid' red check held to 23.4s; caption 'and pays from a phone.' leaves after 23.2s. At 23.6s cut to a kitchen pass: black ticket printer on a steel counter under a ticket rail and heat lamp, an empty wok on a gas burner at right, window behind. No cook visible. New label 'Illustration of the reported pay-first order. Generic printer and wok'.

Samples 24.0s to 24.8s of option A. Kitchen pass held 24.0s to 24.4s with printer idle and empty wok. At 24.6s cut to a shot combining a raised hand with the paid phone on the left and the printer under the ticket rail on the right, blurred background. At 24.8s a red check badge pops off the phone and a dashed arc line extends toward the printer top. Caption 'Nothing is cooked until the order is paid for.'.

Samples 25.0s to 25.8s of option A. The red check badge follows the dashed arc from the phone and lands in the printer's top slot by 25.4s. At 25.6s the printer's small indicator turns red. At 25.8s a closer shot frames the printer under the ticket rail with a glowing red indicator; the caption box covers the lower front of the printer. Caption 'Nothing is cooked until the order is paid for.'.

Samples 26.0s to 26.8s of option A. A paper ticket with a red check and 'Chow mein' prints out of the printer top and rises fully by 26.4s. At 26.6s cut back to the kitchen wide: ticket sits on the printer, a white-sleeved arm with a dark hand enters from the right with a ladle over the wok; at 26.8s the ladle tips into the wok and flames appear under it. Cook's body is outside the frame; only an arm is visible. Caption 'Nothing is cooked until the order is paid for.'.

Samples 27.0s to 27.8s of option A. Kitchen wide: the printed ticket sits on the printer while noodles cook in the wok over tall flames. A white-sleeved arm at the right edge first pours from a ladle, then grips the wok handle; at 27.8s noodles lift a little from the wok. Only an arm and hand of the cook are visible at the frame edge. Caption leaves after 27.0s.

Samples 28.0s to 28.8s of option A. Cut to a back-office desk: plain wall, framed corkboard, teal mug, and a white ledger card sliding in from the right edge; by 28.8s its header reads 'Saving or winning back' over empty ruled rows. Large empty lower frame is dark desk front. Caption from 28.4s: 'The owner says the restaurant saves or wins back $9,650 a month,'. The ledger card is small at the right side and partly off frame.

Samples 29.0s to 29.8s of option A. The ledger card glides left across the desk and settles beside the mug; its header reads 'Saving or winning back' and the ruled rows remain empty, with no dollar figure drawn on the card. Card occupies a small band of the frame; most of the lower frame is dark desk front. Caption carries '$9,650 a month,'.

Samples 30.0s to 30.8s of option A. At 30.2s a closer framing shows the 'Saving or winning back' ledger card larger. At 30.4s a grey blurred block fills part of the card's rows and a tan tag reading '$9,650 a month' swings in; by 30.8s the tag settles pinned over the card's upper right. The card rows remain blank except for the grey block. Caption repeats the figure.

Samples 31.0s to 31.8s of option A. Ledger card with the pinned '$9,650 a month' tag held; the grey smudge visible at 31.0s is gone from 31.2s. No other change. Upper half of frame is a plain wall. Caption unchanged.

Samples 32.0s to 32.8s of option A. Ledger card and tag held to 32.4s (caption absent at 32.4s). At 32.6s a closer framing; caption 'and that's his own count.'. At 32.8s a large wooden rubber stamp with red underside comes down onto the upper-left of the card, covering part of the header. No stamped text yet visible.

Samples 33.0s to 33.8s of option A. The rubber stamp presses the card and lifts, leaving a red outlined stamp whose visible letters read 'OWNER' followed by a letter hidden under the $9,650 tag; the full stamp wording is not readable. At 33.6s cut to a wide back-office view: window with river landscape, corkboard, mug, and the small stamped card on the desk. Caption 'and that's his own count.'.

Samples 34.0s to 34.8s of option A. Wide back-office view held unchanged: window, corkboard, small stamped card with tag and mug on desk. Card details are tiny at this framing. Caption 'and that's his own count.' to 34.4s, absent at 34.6s to 34.8s. No motion visible.

Samples 35.0s to 35.8s of option A. New shot: a raised hand holds the paid phone at upper left; a glass tip jar with a few coins sits on a steel kitchen counter beside a plate, with a wok over flames at the right edge. From 35.6s coins pop out of the phone and arc into the air toward the jar. No cook visible. Caption 'FOX 26 reports that kitchen staff now get all of the tips.'.

Samples 36.0s to 36.8s of option A. A stream of coins and a paper bill arcs from the raised paid phone across to the tip jar on the kitchen counter. At 36.6s cut to a close shot of the jar as coins and a bill drop through its mouth; by 36.8s the pile inside has grown. No kitchen worker shown. Caption 'FOX 26 reports that kitchen staff now get all of the tips.'.

Samples 37.0s to 37.8s of option A. Close jar shot: coins and paper bills keep dropping in and the pile rises to about half the jar by 37.6s. At 37.8s the jar is reframed lower and larger, and the caption box now covers the middle of the jar contents. No people appear. Caption unchanged.

Samples 38.0s to 38.8s of option A. The half-full tip jar sits centre frame. A tan tag enters from the right and settles on the jar front by 38.8s, reading 'FOX 26 reports all to the kitchen'. The caption box covers the jar's middle. No kitchen worker or receiving hand appears.

Samples 39.0s to 39.8s of option A. Tagged tip jar held to 39.4s; caption gone after 39.2s. At 39.6s cut to an almost empty frame: wall above a wide wooden desk with only the edge of a white card protruding at the right border; label 'Illustration of a federal rule. Generic card, no real document'. No caption at 39.6s to 39.8s.

Samples 40.0s to 40.8s of option A. A white rule card slides in from the right and settles by 40.8s: header 'Federal tip pool rule', first row 'If the employer takes no tip credit' with an empty box corner mark at right, dashed divider, second row 'a tip pool may include cooks' with a chef-hat icon. Caption 'When the employer takes no tip credit,'.

Samples 41.0s to 41.8s of option A. The 'Federal tip pool rule' card sits centred on the desk with an empty checkbox beside 'If the employer takes no tip credit' and a chef-hat icon beside 'a tip pool may include cooks'. No change across the five samples. Caption 'When the employer takes no tip credit,'.

Samples 42.0s to 42.8s of option A. Rule card unchanged 42.0s to 42.6s with the checkbox still empty; caption absent at 42.6s. At 42.8s a closer framing enlarges the card; a faint pale highlight appears at the left of 'a tip pool may include cooks'. Caption 'federal rules allow a tip pool with cooks.'. Rule card has been static since about 40.8s.

Samples 43.0s to 43.8s of option A. Close framing of the rule card. A yellow highlight band grows from left to right across 'a tip pool may include cooks', covering the full line and the chef-hat icon by 43.8s. The 'no tip credit' checkbox stays empty. Caption 'federal rules allow a tip pool with cooks.'.

Samples 44.0s to 44.8s of option A. Card pushes closer at 44.2s. At 44.4s a hand in a purple sleeve holding a pen enters from below and covers the top row. By 44.8s the hand has gone and a dark ink arc remains, starting at 'no tip credit', looping over the empty checkbox and descending at the right edge toward the highlighted cooks line. The checkbox itself is not ticked. Caption 'federal rules allow a tip pool with cooks.'.

Samples 45.0s to 45.8s of option A. The pen closes a large ink oval that encircles both rows of the rule card. From 45.2s the hand and purple forearm stay parked over the middle of the card, covering parts of 'If the employer takes' and 'a tip pool may include cooks' through 45.8s. Checkbox remains empty. Caption gone at 45.6s to 45.8s.

Samples 46.0s to 46.8s of option A. Wider desk view: the circled rule card sits cut off at the left edge while the rest of the desk is empty. At 46.6s a manila folder with a tab reading 'Restaurant' slides in from the right edge. Label 'Illustration of a gap in the reports. Generic folder, no real records'. Caption from 46.4s 'No report says whether this restaurant takes one.'.

Samples 47.0s to 47.8s of option A. The 'Restaurant' folder settles beside the circled rule card, then a closer shot at 47.4s. The folder cover slides away at 47.6s and by 47.8s reveals a white form reading 'Takes no tip credit?' with an empty checkbox and three blank lines. Caption 'No report says whether this restaurant takes one.'.

Samples 48.0s to 48.8s of option A. The folder form 'Takes no tip credit?' is held with its checkbox empty. From 48.4s a question mark fades in beside the checkbox and becomes solid black by 48.8s. Caption 'No report says whether this restaurant takes one.'.

Samples 49.0s to 49.8s of option A. Question-mark form held to 49.2s. At 49.4s cut to a table-level shot: a hand with lighter skin and a blue sleeve holds a phone tilted toward the QR table tent; the phone screen shows a dimmed grey QR. Label 'Illustration of a reported customer remark. Generic phone, no real person'. At 49.8s caption 'One customer said QR codes don't suit people like her mother.' sits over the phone screen.

Samples 50.0s to 50.8s of option A. The lighter-skinned hand moves the phone around the QR table tent: in front at 50.0s, raised and to the left at 50.2s to 50.6s, lowered in front of the tent at 50.8s. The phone screen continues to show a QR image; no menu or failure state appears. Caption 'One customer said QR codes don't suit people like her mother.' crosses the lower phone and forearm.

Samples 51.0s to 51.8s of option A. At 51.0s the hand lowers the phone near the QR tent. At 51.2s cut to a wider flatter view: small QR tent and a dark phone lying face up on the table at left, nobody present. A quote card enters from the right reading '"not very convenient for every kind of people"' attributed 'One customer', with a grey blurred block below it, settling by 51.8s. Caption unchanged.

Samples 52.0s to 52.8s of option A. Flat wide view: a dark phone lying on the table, a small QR tent and the quote card '"not very convenient for every kind of people" One customer' beside it. All three objects sit in a thin horizontal band at mid-frame; the upper half and lower third are empty beige. No person. Frame unchanged from 52.2s. Caption unchanged.

Samples 53.0s to 53.8s of option A. The flat quote tableau holds to 53.6s (caption gone at 53.6s); this tableau has been static since about 52.2s. At 53.8s cut to a wide room shot: Haniya tablet on its pole stand at left in front of the window, a counter at right with a full tip jar and printer holding a ticket. Label 'Illustration. Generic panel and jar, no real records'. No person. No caption at 53.8s.

Samples 54.0s to 54.8s of option A. Wide room shot with the Haniya panel at left and counter, tip jar and printer at right. From 54.4s a small 'Chow mein' order row with a red check appears on the panel, and a tiny ticket lifts off and travels along a dashed arc toward the printer. These elements are small at phone size. Caption from 54.2s 'So software now takes the order,'.

Samples 55.0s to 55.8s of option A. The mini ticket finishes its arc and lands at the printer by 55.2s; the dashed line disappears. The panel keeps the small Chow mein row with a check. Wide held unchanged 55.4s to 55.8s. Caption 'So software now takes the order,'.

Samples 56.0s to 56.8s of option A. Wide room shot held 56.0s to 56.6s; this wide has held since about 55.4s with no new change. At 56.8s cut to a close shot of the full tip jar on the counter with a tag edge reading 'Ow' entering from the right. Caption 'and who gets the tip rests on the owner's word.'.

Samples 57.0s to 57.8s of option A. Close shot of the full tip jar; a white tag reading 'owner says' swings in from the right and settles pinned to the jar front by 57.8s. Caption 'and who gets the tip rests on the owner's word.'. No person visible.

Samples 58.0s to 58.8s of option A. Close jar with 'owner says' tag to 58.2s, then at 58.4s a medium room shot: the Haniya panel with its order row at left, the counter with the tagged jar and printer at right. A second tag swings in from the left edge and by 58.8s reads '...record shown', its first word still outside the frame. Caption 'and who gets the tip rests on the owner's word.'.

Samples 59.0s to 59.8s of option A. The 'no record shown' tag swings from left to right across the frame and settles stacked below the 'owner says' tag on the tip jar; together the two tags cover most of the jar body by 59.6s. Haniya panel with its order row stays at left, printer at right. Caption 'and who gets the tip rests on the owner's word.'.

Samples 60.0s to 60.8s of option A. The closing room tableau (Haniya panel with order row, tip jar under 'owner says' and 'no record shown' tags, printer) holds to 60.4s; caption ends after 60.0s. At 60.6s cut to a dark credits card with a Lone Star flag, 'Texas AI Docket', 'Visit the Docket texasaidocket.com', sources 'FOX 26 Houston, Muslim Mirror, KPRC Click2Houston, Federal tip pool rule' and 'Original authored diagrams, no brand marks'.

Samples 61.0s to 61.8s of option A. Static dark credits card: Lone Star flag, 'Texas AI Docket', 'Visit the Docket texasaidocket.com', four sources and the illustration note. No change across samples.

Samples 62.0s to 62.8s of option A. Same static dark credits card as 60.6s onward, with Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com, four sources and illustration note. No visible change.
Samples 63.0s to 63.8s of option A. Static dark credits card unchanged: Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com, four sources and illustration note.
Samples 64.0s to 64.8s of option A. Static dark credits card unchanged: Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com, four sources and illustration note.

Samples 65.0s, 65.2s, 65.4s and final frame 65.433s of option A. Static dark credits card unchanged through the final frame: Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com, four sources and illustration note. Option A sequence ends here.

Samples 0.0s to 0.8s of option B. Overhead plan of a small restaurant: two round tables with three diners seen from above, a host stand with pad and phone beside the left door, a long counter at right. From 0.2s a trail of small footprints appears leading from the host stand out through the door, whose swing arc opens. Plan occupies the upper two thirds; lower third empty beige. Caption 'When the only server at Wok and Karahi in Spring walked out,'.

Samples 1.0s to 1.8s of option B. Overhead plan: the footprint trail now leads from the host stand out past the door to outside the wall; the door swings back toward closed. Faint ring marks appear by the phone on the host stand from 1.4s. Diners unchanged. Caption 'When the only server at Wok and Karahi in Spring walked out,'.

Samples 2.0s to 2.8s of option B. Overhead plan with the exit footprint trail held to 2.4s while a Texas outline locator card fades in at top-right. At 2.6s cut to an eye-level view: a wooden host stand with a black desk phone and a dark apron hanging from it, glass door edge with a bell at left, window behind. Caption overlaps the lower stand and apron. Caption 'When the only server at Wok and Karahi in Spring walked out,'.

Samples 3.0s to 3.8s of option B. Eye-level host stand shot held: desk phone, hanging apron, door edge with bell. Texas locator outline draws around the state. At 3.6s ring arcs appear beside the phone. No hand or person. Caption 'When the only server at Wok and Karahi in Spring walked out,' covers the lower stand.

Samples 4.0s to 4.8s of option B. Host stand shot held; phone ring arcs pulse on and off. The Texas locator outline is complete with a small mark near the upper Gulf coast. Caption gone at 4.6s to 4.8s, showing the hanging apron and stand base. Nobody answers the phone.

Samples 5.0s to 5.8s of option B. Cut to a low shot from behind the empty host stand: a blank lined order pad with a pencil in the foreground, the ringing phone at the left edge, and behind it an orange-shirted diner reading a menu who raises a hand by 5.4s, plus a purple-shirted diner at a second table. Texas locator circles the Houston area at 5.6s. Caption 'who was going to take the order?'.

Samples 6.0s to 6.8s of option B. Same shot from behind the empty host stand: blank order pad and pencil in foreground, phone ringing at left, orange diner with arm fully raised behind a menu, purple diner seated. Nobody comes. Caption 'who was going to take the order?'.

Samples 7.0s to 7.8s of option B. Host-stand foreground shot with the raised-hand diner held to 7.6s; caption leaves after 7.2s. At 7.8s cut to an entrance wide: glass door with bell, a blank white sign hanging in the window, a black tablet on a pole stand beside the host stand with phone and apron, and a small seated diner in green at a table. Label 'Illustration. Generic panel, no real software or brand mark'.

Samples 8.0s to 8.8s of option B. Entrance wide held: glass door, blank hanging sign that tilts a little and settles, dark tablet on a stand, host stand with phone and apron, a seated diner in green at a small table. Locator fades at 8.0s. Caption from 8.2s 'The family didn't post a job ad.'. The sign has no lettering.

Samples 9.0s to 9.8s of option B. Entrance wide unchanged: blank hanging sign, dark tablet, host stand with phone and apron, seated diner in green. Caption 'The family didn't post a job ad.' throughout. No visible motion across samples.

Samples 10.0s to 10.8s of option B. Entrance wide still unchanged since about 8.6s: blank sign, dark tablet, host stand, diner in green. Caption 'The family didn't post a job ad.' to 10.4s, absent 10.6s to 10.8s. No motion visible.

Samples 11.0s to 11.8s of option B. Medium shot of the tablet on its pole stand beside the host stand with phone and apron. The black screen wipes to teal from 11.4s and by 11.8s shows a ring icon and the name 'Haniya'. Caption 'They put an AI host named Haniya at the front of the house.'.
Samples 12.0s to 12.8s of option B. Medium shot held: Haniya tablet with a faint glow beside the host stand. Caption unchanged. No motion across samples.

Samples 13.0s to 13.8s of option B. Medium shot held to 13.2s; at 13.4s cut to a large close-up of the Haniya tablet against a blurred background. A paper tag reading 'AI host' swings in from the upper left and by 13.8s hangs at the panel's top-left corner. Caption covers the lower edge of the panel.

Samples 14.0s to 14.8s of option B. Close-up of the Haniya tablet; the 'AI host' tag swings across and settles pinned at the panel's upper right by 14.2s, then holds. Caption covers the bottom edge of the panel.

Samples 15.0s to 15.8s of option B. Haniya close-up with tag held to 15.4s; caption leaves after 15.2s. At 15.6s cut to an overhead view of a square table: plate, menu, chopsticks, small glass and a QR code stand at centre; a brown hand at the bottom holds a phone whose screen shows a QR code. Label 'Illustration of the reported ordering flow. Generic phone, not a real code or screen'. No caption at 15.6s to 15.8s.

Samples 16.0s to 16.8s of option B. Overhead table: the hand carries the phone up from the bottom edge across the table, passing behind the caption band at 16.2s to 16.4s, and by 16.8s holds the phone directly over the QR stand, partly covering it. The phone screen shows a QR image throughout. Caption 'A guest scans a code at the table,'.

Samples 17.0s to 17.8s of option B. Overhead: the hand holds the phone directly over the table's QR stand, the phone screen displaying a QR image, the stand's corner visible at the phone's edge. At 17.8s a small orange-red strip appears at the bottom of the phone screen. Forearm crosses the caption band. Caption 'A guest scans a code at the table,'.

Samples 18.0s to 18.8s of option B. Overhead: while the phone stays over the QR stand, its screen changes from the QR image to a menu list (one row reads 'Chow mein') with Talk and Pay buttons at the bottom; text is very small at phone size. Caption to 18.6s, absent at 18.8s.

Samples 19.0s to 19.8s of option B. Overhead phone shot at 19.0s with a brown-skinned hand. At 19.2s cut to an eye-level table view: the phone is now held in a light-skinned hand in a blue sleeve, a woman in purple sits across the table, QR stand at right. A second light-skinned hand reaches in and its index finger touches the Chow mein row by 19.6s; the row turns yellow at 19.8s. The holding hand's skin tone differs from the brown hand in the preceding overhead shot. Caption 'taps or talks to order,'.

Samples 20.0s to 20.8s of option B. Eye-level table: the tapping hand withdraws downward past the QR stand by 20.4s; the held phone keeps the Chow mein row highlighted yellow through 20.8s.
